page.title: Messages
page.description: WhatsApp connection, automatic notification rules and message templates.
templates.title: Message and notification templates
templates.description: Edit the title and text per channel for every notification type. Untouched templates use the system default.
templates.read_only: Only the business owner can edit templates.
editor.title: {{type}} template
editor.description: Click a placeholder to insert it. The preview updates live with sample data.
editor.subject: Title
editor.subject_hint: WhatsApp and SMS messages do not include the title.
editor.active_hint: A passive template disables this channel for the notification.
editor.reset_confirm: Reset this template to the system default?
editor.test_hint: Sends the saved Turkish template with sample data over the selected channel.
prefs.title: My notifications in this business
prefs.description: Choose which notifications you receive on which channel. WhatsApp and SMS need a phone number.
prefs.phone_hint: The business WhatsApp line sends messages to this number.
prefs.phone_required: Enter a phone number before enabling WhatsApp or SMS.
prefs.error: Notification preferences could not be loaded.
prefs.default_hint: Default: in-app on, WhatsApp on when a phone is set.
daily_summary.title: End-of-day summary
daily_summary.description: At closing time the day's summary is sent over WhatsApp to the people you select: vehicles served per service, revenue (cash / card / account), unpaid jobs, expenses and cash balances.
daily_summary.not_connected: WhatsApp is not connected. The summary is sent from the business WhatsApp line; connect it above first.
daily_summary.send_time_hint: Turkey time; the day's summary is sent once at this time.
daily_summary.recipients_hint: The summary includes revenue and cash figures; select authorised people only. It goes to each person's notification phone.
daily_summary.no_phone_hint: Cannot be sent to people without a notification phone: {{names}}.
daily_summary.no_phone_link: Add it under Profile → notification settings.
daily_summary.preview_hint: Preview of the WhatsApp message with today's data.
daily_summary.errors.WHATSAPP_NOT_CONNEC: WhatsApp is not connected; connect it first.
daily_summary.errors.NO_RECIPIENT_PHONE: None of the selected recipients has a notification phone.
daily_summary.errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid settings: select at least one recipient and enter the time as HH:MM.
daily_summary.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
vehicle_alerts.title: Vehicle alerts (team)
vehicle_alerts.description: When a vehicle is accepted, delivered or cancelled, the selected team members are notified. In-app and web push are instant; members without web push get a WhatsApp message from the business line.
vehicle_alerts.not_connected: WhatsApp is not connected: recipients without web push only get in-app notifications. Connect WhatsApp above for WhatsApp messages.
vehicle_alerts.frequency_hint: Batched options send all activity in the window as one message (for busy locations). In-app notifications are always instant.
vehicle_alerts.no_services: No active services in the catalog.
vehicle_alerts.recipients_hint: Staff get vehicle details; amounts are shown to owners only.
vehicle_alerts.no_channel_hint: People without web push or a notification phone only see alerts in the app: {{names}}.
vehicle_alerts.no_channel_link: Add a phone or enable push under Profile → notification settings.
vehicle_alerts.test_skipped: WhatsApp not sent (no phone or WhatsApp not connected): {{names}}
vehicle_alerts.errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid settings: select at least one event and one recipient.
vehicle_alerts.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
toast.connect_failed: Could not start the WhatsApp connection.
wa.title: WhatsApp connection
wa.description: Connect your WhatsApp account to send automatic notifications to customers.
wa.scan: Scan the QR code with your WhatsApp app:
wa.disconnect_body: This ends the WhatsApp session and automatic notifications will stop. Continue?
rules.title: Notification rules
rules.description: Choose which events notify through which channel, and edit message templates.
rules.simulate_body: Sends the created → contract → ready → delivered → paid messages in order as a test.
wa.description_platform: Notifications are sent from the platform's WhatsApp number. Sending from your own number requires the "Own WhatsApp number" feature in your plan.
wa.locked_title: Own number is not included in your plan
wa.locked_body: Messages to your customers are sent from the platform number using the platform templates. Upgrade to a plan with "Own WhatsApp number" to connect your own WhatsApp number and edit message texts.
wa.fallback_label: Use the platform number if my session is disconnected
wa.fallback_hint: When off, messages sent while your number is disconnected fail with a "session disconnected" error.
toast.session_settings_failed: Could not save the sending setting.
templates.platform_body: Your plan does not include "Own WhatsApp number", so WhatsApp messages are sent from the platform number with the platform's approved templates. The texts here are read-only.
outbound.title: Delivery log
outbound.description: Sent WhatsApp and SMS messages: which number sent them, delivery status and failure reason.
outbound.error: Could not load the delivery log.
outbound.empty_description: Automatic notifications appear here once they are sent.
errors.feature_not_entitled: WhatsApp sending is not included in your plan
errors.template_not_approved: Message template is not approved by Meta yet
errors.rate_limited: Rate limited; will be retried later
errors.marketing_limit: Meta limited messages to this recipient
errors.undeliverable: Message could not be delivered to the recipient
channels.title: Messaging channels
channels.description: Choose which channels deliver messages to customers and your team. Connect your own Netgsm or Twilio account for SMS; one SMS provider can be active at a time.
channels.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
channels.whatsapp.subtitle: Your own number or the platform number
channels.whatsapp.description: Job, contract, sale and quote notifications go out over WhatsApp. Pair your own number with a QR code on the Connection tab.
channels.email.title: E-mail
channels.email.subtitle: Through the platform
channels.email.description: Quote and team notifications are e-mailed through the platform's delivery service; no setup needed.
channels.sms.title: SMS – {{provider}}
sms.providers.netgsm.name: Netgsm
sms.providers.netgsm.subtitle: Turkey
sms.providers.netgsm.description: Send SMS from your approved message header (sender name) with your Netgsm account. Turkish characters use Netgsm's Turkish encoding.
sms.providers.netgsm.form_hint: Enter the subscriber number (user code), API password and approved message header from your Netgsm panel. If API access is IP-restricted, allow our server IP.
sms.providers.twilio.name: Twilio
sms.providers.twilio.subtitle: International
sms.providers.twilio.description: Send SMS to international numbers with your Twilio account. Use a Twilio number, an alphanumeric sender id or a Messaging Service SID as the sender.
sms.providers.twilio.form_hint: Enter the Account SID and Auth Token from the Twilio Console. They are encrypted for your business only and never shown again.
sms.sender.msgheader_hint: Your approved Netgsm sender name (e.g. COMPANY).
sms.sender.from_hint: Twilio number (+1…), alphanumeric sender id or Messaging Service SID (MG…).
sms.form.keep_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved value
sms.form.activate_hint: SMS notifications are sent through this provider.
sms.form.activate_switch_hint: Turning it on deactivates the other SMS provider.
sms.test.title: Test SMS with {{provider}}
sms.test.description: Send a test message to a number to verify the connection. It appears in the delivery log.
sms.test.phone_hint: Turkish numbers as 05…, others with the country code (+44…).
sms.test.default_body: Otopoly test message: your SMS channel works.
sms.disconnect.title: Disconnect {{provider}}?
sms.disconnect.body: The saved credentials are deleted. If this provider is active, SMS notifications stop.
sms.use_as_channel_hint: When on, SMS notifications go through this provider.
sms.toast.save_failed: Could not save the SMS provider
sms.segments.ucs2_hint: Emoji or special characters cut an SMS part to 70 characters.
rules.sms_needs_provider: For SMS, connect and activate an SMS provider on the Channels tab first.
channel_picker.label: Delivery channel
channel_picker.hint: SMS is sent through your active SMS provider.
channel_picker.sms_unavailable: Connect Netgsm or Twilio on the Channels tab to use SMS.
channel_picker.sms_not_ready: No active SMS provider. Connect and activate Netgsm or Twilio on the Channels tab.
errors.sms_rejected: The SMS provider rejected the message
errors.sms_outcome_unknown: The SMS provider did not answer; the message may have been sent
daily_summary.errors.SMS_NOT_CONFIGURED: No active SMS provider; connect one on the Channels tab.
errors.sms_feature_not_entitled: SMS sending is not included in your plan
platform_report.title: SMS report
platform_report.description: SMS sent by businesses through their own Netgsm / Twilio accounts: totals, provider split and usage per business.
platform_report.forbidden: You are not allowed to view the SMS report.
platform_report.error: Could not load the SMS report.
platform_report.range_invalid: The end date cannot be before the start date.
platform_report.organizations_hint: Businesses with an SMS provider or SMS traffic in this range. Quota is the current month's usage. Click a row for details.
platform_report.empty_description: No business has connected an SMS provider or sent SMS yet.
platform_report.org_description: The business's latest SMS. Numbers are masked.
platform_report.org_empty_hint: This business has not sent any SMS yet.
